title: GitHub PR Review Mode, Sidebar Git Operations, AI Commit Messages & Unified SSE Streaming
summary: Introduces full GitHub Pull Request review mode with threaded inline comments and agent batch execution, a dedicated sidebar Git panel with staging, sync tracking, and AI-powered commit message generation, unified Server-Sent Events streaming for metrics and Git status, and jump-to-source diff navigation.

categories.name: GitHub Pull Request Review Mode
items: Instant PR checkout and inspection in isolated temporary worktrees using px0 <pr-url> or palette commands
Zero-dependency GitHub client and extensible GitProvider forge abstraction with token configuration
Merge-base diff calculation against target base branches with automated fallback handling
Interactive PR review bar supporting approval, request changes, and general review comments
Inline line comments and threaded replies with diff line anchoring and collapsible comments panel
Batch apply action to dispatch all drafted review comments to the AI coding agent in one click
Real-time file watching and automatic reloading of PR worktrees during active agent modifications
Resolved symlink mismatches on temporary PR checkout paths across macOS and Linux environments

categories.name: Sidebar Git Operations & AI Commit Generation
items: Dedicated collapsible sidebar Git panel displaying active branch status, ahead/behind sync counts, and recent commit history
Integrated Git staging workflows with stage/unstage toggle buttons in file tree rows
Direct commit, push, and pull actions with automated upstream branch resolution and fast-forward pulls
AI-powered commit message generation via configured harnesses with custom prompt rules via git.commitMessageInstruction
Auto-commit pipeline and automatic staging of unstaged changes when requesting an AI commit message on an empty stage
Enlarged, resizable Git sidebar panel with flexible height capping and clear visual hierarchy

categories.name: Diff Navigation & UI Polish
items: Direct jump-to-source navigation when clicking diff line numbers or switching from diff to editor tabs
Streamlined line gutter actions opening inline AI edit directly on click
Standardized border radii, elevation shadows, and flat square toggle switches across all themes
Explicit save button, status indicators, and Ctrl+S shortcut for settings modal with multiline textarea support
Semantic color styling and loading feedback across review and sync buttons

categories.name: Unified Streaming, Developer Ergonomics & Tooling
items: Unified /api/stream endpoint multiplexing real-time Git status and runtime metrics over Server-Sent Events
Eliminated periodic metrics polling, reducing background network requests while preserving memory scavenger idle timeouts
Verbose request logging under --verbose tracking HTTP response codes, transferred bytes, and handler latency
Modal Vim improvement delegating Escape keypress to exit Visual and Insert modes before global modal dismissals
Resolved bundling namespace collisions and automated web bundle CI testing pipeline
